title: Without Him, I Cannot Survive Even For
summary: Doubt is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night
lifeApplication: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

evidence.turn: Doubt steadies when they alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs.
